cases.name: Air, heat and water in equal what leaves
cases.result: A 2 x 2 x 2.4 m room at 100 L/s and 14 °C with a 500 W, 100 g/h person: the air leaves at 18.161 °C against 18.142 °C from the heat balance (0.46 % of the rise); 100.00 L/s in and out; a fan coil's return air within 0.02 % of the rise (tools/cfd-test/test-room.mjs)

cases.name: Nothing to change stays unchanged
cases.result: Supply air the same as the room air: the temperature stays exact and the mean humidity ratio within 0.05 %; a cold supply alone brings the room to the supply temperature within 0.01 K

cases.name: Symmetry
cases.result: A room symmetric across x stays symmetric to 0.0001 K, and its two returns take the same air

cases.name: The solver's buoyancy, closed box
cases.result: The 3-D differentially heated air cube against the numerical benchmark of Tric, Labrosse and Betrouni (2000): Nu 4.308 against 4.337 at Ra 1e5 on 48 cells (0.11, engineering-11); numerical, laminar, not a measured room

cases.name: In BimCraft, in the page
cases.result: The showcase house with a diffuser, a grille and a fan coil placed with BimCraft's equipment: terminals and airflows read from the model, 60 s of air on 11,880 cells in about 30 s, numbers, coloured plane and CSV shown, nothing written into the model (tools/bimcraft-test/browser-roomair-bim.mjs, 23 checks)
